<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
# Key deductions in order

print("=== SOLVING THE PUZZLE ===\n")

# Given fact
print("1. GIVEN: Yoland tells the truth")
yoland = True

# From statement 7
print("2. FROM stmt 7: Delbert says Yoland tells truth")
print("   Since Yoland = TRUE, Delbert = TRUE")
delbert = True

# Statements 28 and 46 (paired)
print("\n3. FROM stmts 28 & 46: Oliver and Marvin make opposite claims about each other")
print("   They must both be the same (both T or both L)")

# Statement 2
print("\n4. FROM stmt 2: Alejandro says exactly 2 of {Alexis, Oliver, Marvin} tell truth")
print("   If Oliver=T, Marvin=T: exactly 2 requires Alexis=F, so Alejandro=T")
print("   If Oliver=F, Marvin=F: impossible to have exactly 2 T")
print("   Therefore: Oliver=T, Marvin=T, Alexis=F, Alejandro=T")
oliver = marvin = True
alexis = False
alejandro = True

# Statement 21
print("\n5. FROM stmt 21: Alexis says Willian lies")
print("   Alexis = FALSE (lies), so opposite: Willian = TRUE")
willian = True

# Statement 50
print("\n6. FROM stmt 50: Willian says '2 or 0 of {Raymond, Madeleine, Owen} tell truth'")
print("   Willian = TRUE, so one of these must hold")
print("   Stmts 4 & 5: Madeleine and Owen are paired")
print("   Case 1: Both T → need Raymond=F for exactly 2")
print("   Case 2: Both F → need Raymond=F for exactly 0")
print("   Either way: Raymond = FALSE")
raymond = False

# Statement 23
print("\n7. FROM stmt 23: Raymond says Christie tells truth")
print("   Raymond = FALSE (lies), so Christie = FALSE")
christie = False

# Statement 16
print("\n8. FROM stmt 16: Christie says Ryan lies")
print("   Christie = FALSE (lies), so Ryan = TRUE")
ryan = True

# Statement 1
print("\n9. FROM stmt 1: Ryan says '2 or 0 of {Kandi, Odette, Meredith} tell truth'")
print("   Ryan = TRUE, so this holds")
print("   Stmts 11 & 45: Odette and Meredith are paired")
print("   Either both T or both L → either way need Kandi=F for 2 or 0")
print("   Therefore: Kandi = FALSE")
kandi = False

# Statement 39
print("\n10. FROM stmt 39: Antwan says '1 of {Alejandro, Olga, Ozzie} lies'")
print("    Alejandro = TRUE")
print("    Stmts 3 & 12: Olga and Ozzie are opposite (one T, one L)")
print("    So exactly 1 lies total (the one of Olga/Ozzie that's F)")
print("    Statement is true: Antwan = TRUE")
antwan = True

# Statement 6
print("\n11. FROM stmt 6: Fletcher says 'only 1 of {Antwan, Morgan, Olympia} lies'")
print("    Antwan = TRUE")
print("    Stmts 33 & 47: Olympia and Morgan are opposite")
print("    So exactly 1 of {Antwan, Morgan, Olympia} lies (from Morgan/Olympia)")
print("    Statement is true: Fletcher = TRUE")
fletcher = True

# Statement 43
print("\n12. FROM stmt 43: Jaymie says 'exactly 2 of {Rashida, Millie, Octavian} tell truth'")
print("    Stmts 8 & 15: Millie and Octavian are paired")
print("    Case 1: Both T → need Rashida=F for exactly 2, Jaymie=T")
print("    Case 2: Both F → can't get exactly 2, so Jaymie=F (statement false)")
print("    But if Jaymie=F, stmt says 'exactly 2' when we have ≤1, consistent")
print("    Let's try Case 1: Millie=T, Octavian=T, Rashida=F, Jaymie=T")
millie = octavian = jaymie = True
rashida = False

# Statement 41
print("\n13. FROM stmt 41: Jim says 'only 1 of {Jaymie, Osian, Olaf} lies'")
print("    Jaymie = TRUE (doesn't lie)")
print("    Stmts 14 & 44: Olaf and Osian are opposite")
print("    So exactly 1 of {Jaymie, Osian, Olaf} lies → Jim=T")
jim = True

# Statement 19
print("\n14. FROM stmt 19: Sherrie says 'exactly 2 of {Jim, Osric, Omar} tell truth'")
print("    Jim = TRUE")
print("    Stmts 20 & 51: Osric and Omar are paired")
print("    Case 1: Osric=T, Omar=T → 3 T total, not exactly 2, Sherrie=F")
print("    Case 2: Osric=F, Omar=F → 1 T total, not exactly 2, Sherrie=F")
print("    Either way: Sherrie = FALSE")
sherrie = False

# Statement 30
print("\n15. FROM stmt 30: Vernell says 'all 3 or only 1 of {Sherrie, Maynard, Marina} tell truth'")
print("    Sherrie = FALSE")
print("    Stmts 18 & 48: Marina and Maynard are paired")
print("    Case 1: Both T → {F, T, T} = 2 T, neither all 3 nor 1, Vernell=F")
print("    Case 2: Both F → {F, F, F} = 0 T, neither all 3 nor 1, Vernell=F")
print("    Either way: Vernell = FALSE")
vernell = False

print("\n" + "="*50)
print("FINAL ANSWERS:")
print(f"  Vernell: {vernell} → {'yes' if vernell else 'no'}")
print(f"  Sherrie: {sherrie} → {'yes' if sherrie else 'no'}")
print(f"  Fletcher: {fletcher} → {'yes' if fletcher else 'no'}")
print("="*50)

EOF
</parameter>
